Board settings

Corner tag IDs

AprilTag 16h5 · four different IDs from 0 to 29

Dimension limits
  • Board: 80–240 mm, at least four tag widths.
  • Tags: 12–50 mm.
  • Outer margin: at least 2 mm or 15% of the tag edge, whichever is greater.
  • Leave at least one tag-width of white space between the inner tag edges.

Loading installer…

Installation clears saved scans and calibration. Run CALIBRATE afterward.

Connection help

Browser flashing requires HTTPS or localhost and a desktop browser with Web Serial support, such as Chrome or Edge. If the board is missing, try another data cable or USB port. To enter download mode, hold BOOT, press and release RESET, then release BOOT. Reconnect and choose the new port.

STEP 3

Calibrate and scan

  1. Calibrate the camera

    On the round display, tap CALIBRATE. Capture varied board angles and distances with at least three tags visible. The device saves a successful calibration.

  2. Capture the object

    Place a small colored or dark object in the center. Tap START SCAN and follow the on-screen guidance. Hold still at each target to capture automatically.

  3. Generate the mesh

    Choose GEN MESH, then drag the model to inspect it. Add more views if needed and save the result on the scanner.

The scanning volume remains approximately 47 mm across, even with a larger board. White objects and hidden concavities are difficult for silhouette-based scanning.
